title: Merge Command Contract

requirement.requirement_goal: Let a contact-management user merge two already-selected duplicate contacts without being diverted into unrelated contact-management capabilities, while keeping the merge result clear and recoverable.
requirement.background: Users clean duplicate records from a contact list by selecting the two records they believe represent the same person and invoking an explicit Merge command. The merge can preserve a pre-merge snapshot for recovery, and the product needs one of the selected records to remain the primary identity after the merge.
requirement.current_state: The contact list already supports selecting two contacts and invoking Merge, but the current interaction opens a broad menu containing Merge, Export, Add tags, Find duplicates, and AI cleanup. This turns a committed Merge command into a general capability catalog and forces the user back into a decision they already made.

input.context: A user is cleaning duplicate records in a contact-management list.
known: Exactly two contact records are already selected.
The product can preserve a pre-merge snapshot for Undo.
unresolved: Which of the two selected contacts should remain the primary record?

expected: Keep the explicit Merge command semantically narrow after invocation.
Reuse the existing two-contact selection as the merge target.
Expose only merge-specific unresolved decisions after Merge.
Allow the user to choose either selected contact as the primary record.
Commit the merge after the primary record is chosen without a redundant generic confirmation stage.
Show the merged result and an Undo recovery path.
Preserve the original selection when the merge surface is dismissed.
Allow pointer and touch presentations to differ without changing merge semantics.
forbidden: Export, Add tags, Find duplicates, or AI cleanup inside the Merge flow
redundant confirmation with no new uncertainty
reviewer or prototype explanation rendered inside the product prototype
